access_links.label: EAGLE-I recorded electricity outages (Figshare item, ORNL)

description: EAGLE-I historic outages 2014-2025 is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. EAGLE-I™ is DOE's interactive geographic information system (GIS) that allows users to view and map the nation's energy infrastructure and obtain near real-time informational updates concerning the electric, petroleum and natural gas sectors within one visualization platform. The entire dataset for 8 years is available for download within the reference link. Coverage: the United States. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are distribution grid outages, customer outages, power outage. The portal shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
